svg.title: Workflow: Ask AI Agent
svg.desc: UML sequence diagram. A grounded answer streamed over SSE: the gateway authenticates and proxies, the agent reserves a daily budget and runs guardrails, retrieval searches the RAG chunks that publishing writes and degrades instead of failing, and run telemetry goes through an outbox so it never blocks the answer. Messages: 1. POST /api/agent/chat; 2. verify JWT session; 3. stream(query, identity); 4. reserve daily budget; 5. budget notice · run ends; 6. load recent turns; 7. input safety check; 8. safe refusal; 9. plan route (intent); 10. search(query, top 6); 11. embed(query); 12. match_current_knowledge_v2; 13. keep active, public evidence; 14. evidence + canonical URLs; 15. error · no stale fallback; 16. answer without evidence; 17. grounded stream; 18. stream; 19. chunk; 20. SSE answer event; 21. SSE event; 22. INSERT run events.
svg.text: A grounded answer streamed over SSE: the gateway authenticates and proxies, the agent reserves a daily budget and runs guardrails, retrieval searches the RAG chunks that publishing writes
and degrades instead of failing, and run telemetry goes through an outbox so it never blocks the answer.
Telemetry never blocks the answer: a scheduled publisher bulk-indexes outbox rows into daily OpenSearch indexes every 5 s, and a failed telemetry write
Result: Grounded answer with canonical sources, inside a daily cost budget
